meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 安装后会把 rtk 挂进指定 agent 容器,并在 settings.json 里加一条 PreToolUse 钩子,使每次 Bash 调用自动经 rtk 过滤。git、cargo、pytest 等开发命令的输出因此被压缩,以降低 token 消耗。
howto.when: 由操作者在宿主机执行:装 rtk、把二进制挂载进容器、写入 PreToolUse 钩子并重启容器。此后每当 Claude 发起 Bash 调用,就会被 rtk 自动接管。

say.note: rtk 会静默拦截该命令

say.text: 运行 pytest 看测试结果
say.note: 输出经 rtk 过滤后返回

say.text: 跑 rtk gain 看省了多少 token
say.note: 显示累计的 token 节省量

howto.what_en: After install, rtk is mounted into the agent container and a PreToolUse hook is added to settings.json, so every Bash call is filtered through rtk, cutting token use on dev commands like git, cargo, pytest, docker.
howto.when_en: Run by an operator: install rtk on the host, mount the binary into a container, add the PreToolUse hook, then restart the container. After that every Bash call is auto-filtered by rtk.

say_en.text: Run pytest and show the results
Run rtk gain to see token savings
